question: Should Workspaces permanently add `builtin:chart` as a tenth trusted first-party widget rather than leaving chart authoring to sandboxed custom widgets?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but choosing which capabilities receive trusted first-party status is a product and long-term maintenance decision that contributor tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the trusted chart
options.body: Sponsor the built-in direction, then require locale synchronization and direct real-Workspaces proof before merge.

options.title: Keep charts custom-only
options.body: Decline the trusted kind and continue directing chart use cases through the existing sandboxed custom-widget surface.

options.title: Pause with the roadmap
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer implementation review until maintainers decide the wider Workspaces widget roadmap.

recommendation.title: Accept the trusted chart
recommendation.body: Sponsor the built-in direction, then require locale synchronization and direct real-Workspaces proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question concerns permanent first-party Workspaces product scope rather than a mechanical implementation repair.
